announcements.headline: West Texas Mining Site Fully Operational
announcements.insight: The West Texas site is now fully operational, following commissioning in August. This marks a key milestone for the project initiated in June.

announcements.headline: Site Commissioning Programme
announcements.insight: Following power commencement in July, this commissioning programme marks a critical operational milestone. Shareholders should monitor for subsequent production data or revenue recognition triggers.

announcements.headline: Commencement of On-Site Power & Issue of Warrants
announcements.insight: Following June contracts and site installation, power commencement and warrant issuance signal operational progress and capital raising. Shareholders should monitor execution risks and dilution from the warrants.

announcements.headline: Subscription, Directors' Dealings, RPT & Equipment
announcements.insight: Directors' dealings are reported. This follows earlier announcements regarding a mining site contract and installation works.

announcements.headline: Installation Works Commence at West Texas Site
announcements.insight: Installation works commence at the West Texas site following the June contract for the mining site and gas purchase agreement. This marks operational progress in the project.

announcements.headline: Entry into Gas Purchase Agreement
announcements.insight: Entry into a Gas Purchase Agreement follows the June mining site contract, indicating operational progression in its digital asset activities.

announcements.headline: Contract for Mining Site & Coinbase Account
announcements.insight: Sterling Digital Plc has entered a contract for a mining site and established a Coinbase account. Shareholders should monitor these developments for further details.
